SELECT s.school AS school_name, sc.avgscrwrite AS avg_writing_score, s.phone AS communication_number
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.cdscode = sc.cds
WHERE s.opendate > '1991-12-31' OR s.closeddate < '2000-01-01'

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    cdscode,
    "Free Meal Count (K-12)" / "Enrollment (K-12)" AS eligible_free_rate,
    "Enrollment (K-12)",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC) AS rn
  FROM frpm
  WHERE "Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL AND "Enrollment (K-12)" != 0
)
SELECT cdscode, eligible_free_rate
FROM ranked
WHERE rn IN (10, 11)
ORDER BY rn;

SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN doc = '54' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
  NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN doc = '52' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE county = 'Orange' AND statustype = 'Merged' AND doc IN ('52','54');

SELECT s.school, s.mailstreet
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = t.cds
WHERE t.avgscrmath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY t.avgscrmath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6

SELECT f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.edopscode = 'SSS'
  AND s.city = 'Fremont'
  AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'

WITH magnet_k8 AS (
  SELECT s.cdscode, s.city
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.magnet = 1 AND s.gsserved = 'K-8'
),
multi_provision AS (
  SELECT m.cdscode
  FROM magnet_k8 m
  JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = m.cdscode
  WHERE f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM multi_provision) AS num_multiple_provision_schools,
  city,
  COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM magnet_k8
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY city;

SELECT f."District Code", CAST(f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS REAL) * 100 / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "Percent Eligible Free (K-12)"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.admfname1 = 'Alusine'

SELECT admemail1
FROM schools
WHERE county = 'San Bernardino'
  AND district = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND opendate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
  AND soc = '62'
  AND doc = '54'
  AND admemail1 IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
AND d.a3 = 'east Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.a11 > 6000 AND d.a11 < 10000

SELECT d.district_id,
       d.a2 AS district_name,
       CAST((d.a13 - d.a12) AS REAL) * 100 / d.a12 AS unemployment_increment_pct
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1 AND l.status IN ('C', 'D')

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.date) = 1998
  AND t.amount < (
      SELECT AVG(amount) FROM trans
      WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
        AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 1998
  );

SELECT DISTINCT d.type
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE d.type <> 'OWNER'
AND dist.a11 > 8000 AND dist.a11 <= 9000

SELECT AVG(d.a15) AS avg_crimes_1995
FROM district d
WHERE d.a15 > 4000
AND d.district_id IN (
    SELECT a.district_id
    FROM account a
    WHERE a.date >= '1997-01-01'
);

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS pct_female
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.a11 > 10000

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS pct_male
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS pct_carbon
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=')

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '='

SELECT m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'h'
GROUP BY m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NUMERIC) * 100 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percentage
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR060';

SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-'
ORDER BY b.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected)
  AND a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected)

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT ROUND(
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NUMERIC) * 100 / COUNT(b.bond_id),
  5
) AS pct_carcinogenic_single_bonds
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percent_cl
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT c.name
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.rarity = 'mythic'
  AND l.format = 'gladiator'
  AND l.status = 'Banned';

SELECT DISTINCT c.name, l.status
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.types = 'Artifact'
  AND c.side IS NULL
  AND l.format = 'vintage';
SELECT DISTINCT bordercolor FROM cards WHERE name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE originaltype = 'Summon - Angel' AND subtypes <> 'Angel';
SELECT id FROM cards WHERE dueldeck = 'a';

SELECT name, manacost
FROM cards
WHERE layout = 'normal'
  AND frameversion = '2003'
  AND bordercolor = 'black'
  AND availability = 'mtgo,paper';

SELECT DISTINCT f.type
FROM foreign_data f
JOIN cards c ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE f.language = 'German'
  AND c.subtypes IS NOT NULL
  AND c.supertypes IS NOT NULL

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.hascontentwarning = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS pct_no_content_warning
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE l.format = 'commander' AND l.status = 'legal'
SELECT DISTINCT language FROM foreign_data WHERE multiverseid = 149934;

SELECT DISTINCT st.language
FROM set_translations st
JOIN sets s ON st.setcode = s.code
WHERE s.mcmname = 'Archenemy' AND s.code = 'ARC';

SELECT DISTINCT s.code, s.name, s.mtgocode
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.setcode = s.code
WHERE c.name = 'Angel of Mercy'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setcode
WHERE s.block = 'Ice Age'
  AND st.language = 'Italian'
  AND st.translation IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT c.artist
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.setcode = s.code
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND c.artist IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Aaron Miller', 'Chippy')

SELECT c.name, l.format
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.edhrecrank = 1 AND l.status = 'Banned'

SELECT s.name
FROM sets s
WHERE s.code IN (
    SELECT setcode FROM set_translations WHERE language = 'Korean'
)
AND s.code NOT IN (
    SELECT setcode FROM set_translations WHERE language LIKE '%Japanese%'
)
SELECT displayname FROM users WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM creationdate) = 2011;

SELECT p.favoritecount
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.postid = p.id
WHERE c.userid = 3025 AND c.creationdate = '2014-04-23 20:29:39.0'

SELECT p.id, CASE WHEN p.closeddate IS NULL THEN 'Not well-finished' ELSE 'Well-finished' END AS status
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.postid = p.id
WHERE c.userid = 23853 AND c.creationdate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id WHERE u.displayname = 'Tiago Pasqualini'

SELECT DISTINCT u.displayname
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.postid = p.id
JOIN users u ON v.userid = u.id
WHERE v.bountyamount = 50
AND p.title ILIKE '%variance%'

SELECT p.tags
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id
WHERE u.displayname = 'Mark Meckes' AND p.commentcount = 0 AND p.tags IS NOT NULL

SELECT CAST(COUNT(pl.id) AS REAL) / 12 AS avg_monthly_links
FROM postlinks pl
JOIN posts p ON pl.postid = p.id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pl.creationdate) = 2010
  AND p.answercount <= 2

SELECT u.displayname
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.userid = u.id
WHERE b.name = 'Autobiographer'
ORDER BY b.date ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id, p.title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id
WHERE u.displayname = 'Harvey Motulsky'
ORDER BY p.viewcount DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.id, p.ownerdisplayname
FROM posts p
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.creaiondate) = 2010
ORDER BY p.favoritecount DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.creaiondate) = 2011 AND u.reputation > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id

SELECT p.viewcount, u.displayname
FROM posts p
JOIN posthistory ph ON ph.postid = p.id
JOIN users u ON u.id = ph.userid
WHERE ph.text = 'Computer Game Datasets'
ORDER BY ph.creationdate DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.commentcount
FROM posts p
ORDER BY p.score DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT excerptpostid, wikipostid FROM tags WHERE tagname = 'sample';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id)
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Super Strength' AND s.height_cm > 200

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND sp.power_name = 'Super Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Gold' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name, ha.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Copycat';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Durability' AND ha.attribute_value < 50;

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Death Touch';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id)
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = 100

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dc_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');
SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg) FROM superhero s JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id WHERE g.gender = 'Female'

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Male'
AND s.weight_kg > (SELECT AVG(weight_kg) * 0.79 FROM superhero)

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.superhero_name, p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.hair_colour_id = s.skin_colour_id
  AND s.hair_colour_id = s.eye_colour_id
  AND s.hair_colour_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination'

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT c.lat, c.lng
FROM circuits c
JOIN races r ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid
WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceid = ra.raceid
WHERE ra.name = 'Bahrain Grand Prix' AND ra.year = 2007 AND r.time IS NULL

SELECT s.url
FROM races r
JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year
WHERE r.raceid = 901

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid
WHERE r.raceid = 872 AND r.time IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.dob DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.nationality
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid
WHERE r.fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(r.fastestlapspeed AS REAL) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms
FROM laptimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverid = d.driverid
JOIN races r ON lt.raceid = r.raceid
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND r.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'
  AND r.year = 2009

SELECT r.name
FROM results res
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = res.driverid
JOIN races r ON r.raceid = res.raceid
WHERE d.forename = 'Alex' AND d.surname = 'Yoong' AND res.position < 20

WITH schumacher_laps AS (
  SELECT l.raceid, l.milliseconds
  FROM laptimes l
  JOIN drivers d ON l.driverid = d.driverid
  WHERE d.forename = 'Michael' AND d.surname = 'Schumacher'
    AND l.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT r.name AS race_name, r.year
FROM schumacher_laps sl
JOIN races r ON sl.raceid = r.raceid
ORDER BY sl.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT nationality FROM drivers ORDER BY dob ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.driverref
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceid = ra.raceid
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid
WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND ra.year = 2007 AND r.position = 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.driverid)
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceid = ra.raceid
WHERE ra.year = 2008 AND ra.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND r.time IS NOT NULL

WITH race AS (
  SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = 2008 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
champion AS (
  SELECT r.milliseconds AS champ_ms
  FROM results r JOIN race ON r.raceid = race.raceid
  WHERE r.position = 1 AND r.time IS NOT NULL
),
last_driver AS (
  SELECT r.milliseconds AS last_ms
  FROM results r JOIN race ON r.raceid = race.raceid
  WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY r.position DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT CAST((last_driver.last_ms - champion.champ_ms) AS REAL) * 100 / last_driver.last_ms AS pct_faster
FROM champion, last_driver;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circuits WHERE location = 'Adelaide' AND country = 'Australia'

SELECT DISTINCT c.name
FROM constructorresults cr
JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorid = c.constructorid
WHERE cr.raceid = 291 AND cr.points = 0;

WITH champ AS (
  SELECT r.year, res.time
  FROM results res
  JOIN races r ON r.raceid = res.raceid
  WHERE res.position = 1 AND res.time IS NOT NULL AND r.year < 1975
)
SELECT year,
  AVG(
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM time::interval) * 3600 +
    EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM time::interval) * 60 +
    EXTRACT(SECOND FROM time::interval)
  ) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM champ
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverid)
FROM drivers d
JOIN laptimes l ON d.driverid = l.driverid
WHERE d.nationality = 'French' AND l.milliseconds < 120000
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results r WHERE r.raceid > 50 AND r.raceid < 100 AND r.statusid = 2 AND r.time IS NOT NULL;

WITH youngest AS (
  SELECT driverid FROM drivers ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 1
),
first_qual AS (
  SELECT r.year, r.name, r.date, r.time
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON q.raceid = r.raceid
  WHERE q.driverid = (SELECT driverid FROM youngest)
  ORDER BY r.date ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT year, name, date, time FROM first_qual;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, AVG(CAST(p.duration AS REAL)) AS avg_duration
FROM drivers d
JOIN pitstops p ON d.driverid = p.driverid
WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.dob) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1985
GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname
ORDER BY avg_duration ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH monaco AS (
  SELECT r.raceid
  FROM races r
  WHERE r.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
)
SELECT SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, c.name, c.nationality
FROM constructorresults cr
JOIN monaco m ON cr.raceid = m.raceid
JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorid = c.constructorid
GROUP BY c.constructorid, c.name, c.nationality
ORDER BY total_points DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM match m
JOIN league l ON m.league_id = l.id
JOIN team t ON t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND m.season = '2009/2010'
  AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal
GROUP BY t.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT l.name
FROM match m
JOIN league l ON l.id = m.league_id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' AND m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal
GROUP BY l.name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, p.birthday::date)) AS age
FROM player p
JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.sprint_speed >= 97
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pa.date::date) >= 2013
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pa.date::date) <= 2015

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pa.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) AS pct_left_foot
FROM player p
JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id
WHERE CAST(SUBSTRING(p.birthday FROM 1 FOR 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1987 AND 1992

SELECT p.player_name,
       CAST(SUM(pa.heading_accuracy) AS REAL) / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) AS avg_heading_accuracy
FROM player p
JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
GROUP BY p.player_name
ORDER BY avg_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT player_name
FROM player
WHERE substr(birthday, 1, 4) = '1970'
  AND substr(birthday, 6, 2) = '10';

WITH borysiuk AS (
  SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS rating
  FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
  WHERE p.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk'
),
puel AS (
  SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS rating
  FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
  WHERE p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel'
)
SELECT CAST((b.rating - p.rating) AS REAL) * 100 / p.rating AS pct_higher
FROM borysiuk b, puel p;

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS avg_overall_rating
FROM player_attributes pa
JOIN player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Pietro Marino';

SELECT pa.date
FROM player_attributes pa
JOIN player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  AND pa.crossing = (
    SELECT MAX(pa2.crossing)
    FROM player_attributes pa2
    JOIN player p2 ON p2.player_api_id = pa2.player_api_id
    WHERE p2.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  )
ORDER BY pa.date ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990';

SELECT
  (SELECT jumping FROM player_attributes WHERE player_api_id = 6) -
  (SELECT jumping FROM player_attributes WHERE player_api_id = 23) AS diff

SELECT player_api_id
FROM player_attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'right'
ORDER BY potential ASC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT DISTINCT ta.buildupplayspeedclass
FROM team_attributes ta
JOIN team t ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

SELECT l.name, COUNT(m.id) AS num_games
FROM match m
JOIN league l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY l.name
ORDER BY num_games DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM match m
JOIN team t ON t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
ORDER BY m.away_team_goal DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.height < 180 AND pa.overall_rating > 70 THEN pa.id END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(pa.id) AS percentage
FROM player_attributes pa
JOIN player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id

SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.diagnosis
FROM patient p
JOIN examination e ON p.id = e.id
WHERE e.thrombosis = 2;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
FROM patient p
JOIN examination e ON p.id = e.id
WHERE e.thrombosis = 1
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."Examination Date") = 1997
  AND p.sex = 'F'

WITH sjs_patients AS (
  SELECT id, birthday, "First Date"
  FROM patient
  WHERE diagnosis LIKE '%SJS%'
),
oldest AS (
  SELECT id, birthday, "First Date"
  FROM sjs_patients
  ORDER BY birthday ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT l.date AS lab_completion_date,
       EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o."First Date") - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.birthday) AS age_at_arrival
FROM oldest o
JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = o.id
ORDER BY l.date DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH max_hgb AS (
  SELECT l.id, l.date, l.hgb
  FROM laboratory l
  WHERE l.hgb IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY l.hgb DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.date) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday)) AS age,
  p.diagnosis
FROM max_hgb m
JOIN patient p ON p.id = m.id;

WITH pat AS (
  SELECT id FROM patient WHERE birthday = '1959-02-18'
),
nov AS (
  SELECT SUM(l."T-CHO") AS s
  FROM laboratory l
  JOIN pat p ON l.id = p.id
  WHERE l.date >= '1981-11-01' AND l.date < '1981-12-01'
),
dec AS (
  SELECT SUM(l."T-CHO") AS s
  FROM laboratory l
  JOIN pat p ON l.id = p.id
  WHERE l.date >= '1981-12-01' AND l.date < '1982-01-01'
)
SELECT CAST((nov.s - dec.s) AS REAL) * 100 / dec.s AS decrease_rate_percent
FROM nov, dec;

SELECT p.id, p.sex, l.ua,
  CASE WHEN (p.sex = 'M' AND l.ua > 8.0) OR (p.sex = 'F' AND l.ua > 6.5) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_normal
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id
WHERE p.id = 57266

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id
WHERE p.sex = 'M'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday) BETWEEN 1936 AND 1956
  AND l.cpk >= 250

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)::int - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday)::int AS age
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id
WHERE l.glu >= 180 AND l."T-CHO" < 250

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id
WHERE p.sex = 'M'
  AND l.wbc > 3.5 AND l.wbc < 9.0
  AND (l.fg <= 150 OR l.fg >= 450)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM laboratory WHERE igg >= 2000

WITH abnormal_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.id
  FROM laboratory l
  WHERE l.igm <= 40 OR l.igm >= 400
)
SELECT p.diagnosis, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM patient p
JOIN abnormal_patients ap ON p.id = ap.id
WHERE p.diagnosis IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.diagnosis
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id
WHERE l.rnp IN ('-', '+-')
AND p.admission = '+'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)
FROM laboratory l
JOIN examination e ON l.id = e.id
WHERE l.sm IN ('-', '+-') AND e.thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
FROM patient p
JOIN examination e ON p.id = e.id
WHERE e.centromea IN ('-', '+-')
  AND e.ssb IN ('-', '+-')
  AND p.sex = 'M'

SELECT ma.major_name
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Angela' AND m.last_name = 'Sanders'

SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(e.event_date,1,4) = '2019' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END), 0)
  - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(e.event_date,1,4) = '2020' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END), 0) AS diff_spent
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id;

SELECT i.date_received
FROM income i
JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Connor' AND m.last_name = 'Hilton' AND i.source = 'Dues';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Advertisement' AND e.event_name IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting')
SELECT SUM(cost) AS total_pizza_cost FROM expense WHERE expense_description = 'Pizza'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS num_members
FROM attendance a
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'

SELECT e.event_name
FROM expense ex
JOIN budget b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
ORDER BY ex.cost ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN ex.cost ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(ex.cost) AS percentage
FROM expense ex
JOIN budget b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id WHERE mj.major_name = 'Physics Teaching'

SELECT e.event_name
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Advertisement'
ORDER BY b.spent DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT e.event_name
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.status = 'Closed' AND b.remaining < 0
ORDER BY b.remaining ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT e.expense_description, SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE ev.event_name = 'October Meeting' AND e.approved = 'true'
GROUP BY e.expense_description

SELECT b.category
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.location = 'MU 215'
  AND e.type = 'Guest Speaker'
  AND b.spent = 0;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN i.amount = 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(m.member_id)
FROM member m
JOIN income i ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.t_shirt_size = 'Medium' AND m.position = 'Member'

SELECT y.customerid
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.customerid = c.customerid
WHERE SUBSTRING(y.date FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2012'
  AND c.segment = 'LAM'
GROUP BY y.customerid
ORDER BY SUM(y.consumption) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT LEFT(ym.date, 4) AS year, SUM(ym.consumption) AS total_consumption
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid
WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
GROUP BY LEFT(ym.date, 4)
ORDER BY total_consumption DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH cons AS (
  SELECT c.segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(y.date,4) = '2012' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(y.date,4) = '2013' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c ON c.customerid = y.customerid
  WHERE c.currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY c.segment
)
SELECT segment,
       CAST((cons_2013 - cons_2012) AS REAL) * 100 / cons_2013 AS pct_increase
FROM cons
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC;

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gasstations WHERE country = 'CZE' AND segment = 'Discount') -
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gasstations WHERE country = 'SVK' AND segment = 'Discount') AS diff

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff
FROM customers
WHERE segment = 'SME'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN y.consumption > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.customerid = c.customerid
WHERE c.segment = 'LAM';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ym.customerid)
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid
WHERE c.currency = 'EUR' AND ym.consumption > 1000

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.customerid = c.customerid
WHERE t.date = '2012-08-25'

WITH spend AS (
  SELECT t.customerid,
         SUM(t.price) AS total_price,
         SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount,
         SUM(t.price * t.amount) AS total_spent
  FROM transactions_1k t
  GROUP BY t.customerid
)
SELECT s.customerid,
       s.total_price / NULLIF(s.total_amount, 0) AS avg_price_per_item,
       c.currency
FROM spend s
JOIN customers c ON c.customerid = s.customerid
ORDER BY s.total_spent DESC
LIMIT 1;
